Passion. cf. अंहोदुःखव्यसनेष्वघम् Nm.-घः N. of a demon, brother of Baka and Pūtanā and commander-in-chief of Kaṁsa. [Being sent by Kaṁsa to Gokula to kill Kṛiṣṇa and Balarāma he assumed the form of a huge serpent 4 yojanas long, and spread himself on the way of the cowherds, keeping his horrid mouth open. The cowherds mistook it for a mountain cavern and entered it, cows and all. But Kṛiṣṇa saw it, and having entered the mouth so stretched himself that he tore it to pieces and rescued his companions.]-घा The Goddess of sin; (pl.) the constellation usually called Maghā. -Comp. -असुरः See अघ above. -अहः (अहन्) a day of impurity (अशौचदिनम्) -आयुस् a. leading a wicked life. -कृद् a. sinful, wicked, evil-doer.-घ्नः = ˚नाशन. -नाश, -नाशन a. [अघं नाशयति] expiatory, destroying sin (such as gifts, muttering holy prayers &c.). (-नः) destroyer of the demon अघ; N. of Kṛiṣṇa. -भोजिन् a. [अघं पापफलकं भुङ्क्ते] a sinful eater (one who cooks and eats for his own sake and not for Gods, Manes guests &c.) -मर्षण a. [अघं मृष्यते उत्पन्नत्वे$पि नाशनेन कर्माक्षमत्वात् सह्यते अनेन मृष्-ल्युट्] expiatory, removing or destroying sin, usually applied to a prayer (सन्ध्या) repeated by Brāhmaṇas (the 19th hymn of

.); सर्वैनसामपध्वंसि जप्यं त्रिष्वघमर्षणं Ak.; यथाश्वमेधः क्रतुराट् सर्वपापापनोदनः । तथाघमर्षणं सूक्तं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥ The most heinous crimes, such as illicit intercourse with a preceptor's wife, one's own mother, sister, daughter-in-law &c. are said to be expiated by repeating this सूक्त thrice in water; पवित्राण्यघमर्षणानि जपन्त्याम्
. -मार a. [अघं मारयति नाशयति; मृ णिच्-अण्] destroying sin, an epithet of Gods (यमो मृत्युरघमारो निर्ऋतः). -रुद् a. [अघं रोदिति स्वकर्माक्षमतया यस्मात्, रुद्-अपा- दाने क्विप्]
'making sin weep and fly', N. of a Mantra which destroys sin; fearfully howling (?).

[अघे व्यसने रोदिति न तत्प्रतीकाराय घटते, क्विप्] one who only weeps in times of calamity, but does not try to get over them. -विषः [अघं व्यसनकारि विषं यस्य] a serpent; fearfully venomous (?). -शंसः अघस्य शंसः; शंस् भावे अच्]
[अघं अनिष्टं शंसति इच्छति; शंस्-अण्] a wicked man, such as a thief.
wicked; sin-destroying (?). -शंसिन् a. reporting or telling one's sin or guilt. -हारः a noted robber; rumour of guilt (?).
अघन [aghana], a. Not solid, a hollow moulding; घनं वाप्यघनं वापि कुर्यात्तु शिल्पवित्तमः
. -मानम् Measurement by the interior of a structure; एवं तद् घनमानमुक्तमघनमानं वक्ष्यते$धुना Māna;33.331-35.
अघर्म [agharma], a. Not hot, cold; ˚अंशु, ˚धामन् the moon whose rays are cold.
अघल [aghala], a. [अघं लाति नाशयति ला-क] Destroying sin.
अघायति [aghāyati], Den. P. To sin, to be malicious; to threaten with ruin.
अघायु [aghāyu], a. Malicious, wicked, sinful, harmful, injurious; अघायुरिन्द्रियारामो मोघं पार्थ स जीवति
अघारिन् [aghārin], a. [अघं व्यसनं ऋच्छति; ऋ-णिनि] Suffering from evil or calamity (व्यसनयुक्त) not anointing (?)
आघट्टक [āghaṭṭaka], a. Moving. -कः The red Apāmārga (Mar. तांबडा आघाडा).
आघट्टना [āghaṭṭanā], 1 Moving, shaking, striking against; रणद्भिराघट्टनया नभस्वतः Śi.1.1.
To strike against, touch; आघट्टया- मास गतागताभ्याम्
आघर्षः [āgharṣḥ] र्षणम् [rṣaṇam], र्षणम् Rubbing, friction, striking against; गण्डस्थलाघर्षगलन्मदोदकद्रवद्रुमस्कन्धनिलायिनो$लयः Śi.12.64. -णी A brush, rubber.
Killing, striking (sometimes used as an adj.)
A cymbal or rattle; उत यत्राघाटाः कर्कर्यः संवदन्ति
N. af a plant (अपामार्ग; Mar. आघाडा).

A blow, stroke; तीव्राघातप्रतिहततरुस्कन्धलग्नैकदन्तः Ś.1.32; कठिन- कुचतट˚
